She read it twice, lit no lamp against the dawn, and decided, after years of silence perched above the sea, that someone out there had finally kept an appointment.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚未醒来。高架桥的路灯依次熄灭，像一句说累了的话。便利店的暖光守着街角，店员打着哈欠煮着关东煮。远处高楼的玻璃幕墙映着残月，偶尔有一列夜班电车驶过，把寂静切开又合拢。早餐铺开始冒白烟，豆浆的香气在微凉的空气里走得很慢。环卫工人的扫帚声由远及近，是这座城市最早的心跳。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves itself by solving a smaller copy of the same problem.\n- Imagine a set of nested boxes: to find the key inside, you open one box, then do the exact same thing with the box inside it.\n- You need a stopping point, like the smallest box that holds nothing but the key, or it would repeat forever.")
